units.source_text: 这时，我处在青春期（我非常坦率地使用这种语言），在我的境遇中发生了一桩令人难以置信的事。

en.t: At that time, I was in adolescence (I use that word quite frankly), and something unbelievable happened in my circumstances.

units.source_text: 一施主的女儿，其美貌闻名遐迩，是神户女校出身的富家千金，一天她忽然向我表白爱慕之情。

en.t: One day, the daughter of a patron, a wealthy young lady from Kobe Girls' School whose beauty was widely known, suddenly confessed her love for me.

units.source_text: 我久久无法相信自己的耳朵。

en.t: For a long time, I could not believe my own ears.
